name: Professional LAB
summary: Polish (per SimplyPrint/Open Filament Database) budget filament brand with a very broad catalogue: many PLA variants, PLA+, PLA-CF, PETG, PETG-CF, ASA, ABS, TPU and PA12-CF15, sold via print-imagine.com and resellers such as 3dstisk.com and Empik. Owner and manufacturer unknown.

oem_relationships.notes: SimplyPrint links the Professional LAB shop to print-imagine.com (Imagine s.c.), the suspected maker of SmartPrint. print-imagine.com's imprint never mentions Professional LAB, so this is weak.

product_lines.name: PLA (standard, Pastel, Meta)
product_lines.notes: 'Meta' finish undefined; mapped to plain PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk / Silk Dual / Silk Tri

additional_notes: Pricing: Empik ~39-60 PLN/kg; 3dstisk EUR 10-15/kg PETG. SimplyPrint links the brand shop to print-imagine.com (Imagine s.c., Cholerzyn, Liszki, Poland), but print-imagine.com's imprint never mentions Professional LAB, so that is a retailer link, not proof of ownership. A search hit for Fiberlab S.A. (Fiberlogy) surfaced but nothing connects it to Professional LAB - not a relationship. The broad catalogue at budget prices suggests private-label sourcing, but that is speculation with no evidence.

provenance.conflicts: Country (Poland) is from SimplyPrint/Open Filament Database; a reseller only says 'European brand'. Owner, legal entity and manufacturer unknown.
